params.1273: Hunt a crimson swift for its delicious meat.
params.1274: Get a <col=FFFFFF>bird snare</col> from Ayleth Beaststalker.
params.1275: <col=FFFFFF>Left-click</col> on the <col=FFFFFF>bird snare</col> in your inventory to set it up near the <col=FFFFFF>crimson swift birds</col>, and wait for one to approach.
params.1276: If the snare is successful, <col=FFFFFF>left-click</col> on it to retrieve the crimson swift and the snare.
params.1277: Birds can break snares without being caught. If this happens, pick the snare up and place it again.
params.2225: Hunting birds gives Hunter XP, as well as meat, bones and feathers which are useful for other skills.
